lines.text: Oxane's Monitoring Workbench, from Artizent. So, what happens after a bank lends the money?

When a bank lends money, the work doesn't stop there. Every month, the borrower sends files to show the loan is still safe. Checking them is careful work, and things are easy to miss. Here's one month at a bank called Calderwood.

lines.caption: portfolio
lines.text: This is Calderwood's month at a glance: each borrower, and how its checks are going.

lines.caption: late
lines.text: First, the paperwork. One report is late, so the system has already chased it.

lines.caption: layout
lines.text: One borrower changed its file layout. The AI matched the new columns itself.

lines.caption: rollforward
lines.text: Next, the numbers. Last month's loans, plus the new ones, should equal this month's.

lines.caption: gap
lines.text: They don't. Some loans have quietly gone missing from the borrower's file.

lines.caption: chargeoffs
lines.text: And the borrower's two reports disagree about which loans were written off.

lines.caption: terms
lines.text: The loan agreement changed in June, so May is still checked against the old terms.

lines.caption: trigger
lines.text: Now, the warning signs. Late payments at one borrower are close to the limit.

lines.caption: whatif
lines.text: One more bad month and the bank stops lending. The analyst can test that now.

lines.caption: leverage
lines.text: Another borrower's debt looks fine, unless a guarantee counts. So an expert decides.

lines.caption: collateral
lines.text: And one car has been used to secure loans with two different borrowers.

lines.caption: triage
lines.text: Everything found goes to one place. The AI suggests, and the analyst decides.

lines.caption: noise
lines.text: Small, harmless differences are set aside, with a reason, so they don't distract.

lines.caption: pack
lines.text: Then the report to the bank. The AI writes it, and every number comes from the checks.

lines.caption: approve
lines.text: The analyst can't sign off their own work, so a second analyst approves and sends it.

lines.caption: results
lines.text: The result: every real problem found, and nothing harmless flagged.
By the end of the day, the bank has its report. Each real problem is with the person who can fix it, and small differences never got in the way. Next month, it all starts again.
Less noise. More certainty. That's the Monitoring Workbench, from Artizent.
